description: Source code implementing functions for manipulating x86 instruction operands, including appending, creating, freeing, and iterating over operand lists, as part of a disassembler library.

methods.name: x86_oplist_append
methods.description: Appends an operand to the instruction's operand list, updating operand counts.

methods.name: x86_operand_new
methods.description: Creates a new operand and adds it to the instruction's operand list.

methods.name: x86_oplist_free
methods.description: Frees all operands associated with an instruction.

methods.name: x86_operand_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over operands of an instruction, applying a callback based on specified operand type filters.

methods.name: x86_operand_count
methods.description: Returns the count of operands of a specified type in an instruction.

methods.name: x86_operand_1st
methods.description: Returns the first operand of an instruction.

methods.name: x86_operand_2nd
methods.description: Returns the second operand of an instruction.

methods.name: x86_operand_3rd
methods.description: Returns the third operand of an instruction.
